comments.body: I thought the recreation of the trustline was a feature and that was the reason for `disallowIncomingTrustline`?

comments.author: scottschurr
comments.body:
Hi @dangell7, in this particular case the recreation of the trust line is a bug.  The NFToken in the bug report does not have the `nft::flagCreateTrustLines` flag set.  So the code should not be spontaneously adding trust lines to the issuer of the NFToken.

The test code that I added may be confusing.  Two NFTokens are created:

- One with `tfTrustLine` and
- One without.  

The NFToken created _with_ `tfTrustLine` is there to verify that my changes don't break the workflow when that trust line is _supposed_ to be created.  The one _without_ `tfTrustLine` tests the reported bug.

NFTokens have a lot of (too many?) options.  So it's easy to get tangled up.

## High Level Overview of Change

Introduces the `fixEnforceNFTokenTrustline ` amendment which fixes bugs in interactions between NFTokenOffers and trust lines.

Resolves #4925.
Resolves #4941.

### Context of Change

#### #4925

This issue describes a wide timing window that causes a rare bug.  To understand the process you need some background in how NFTokens work.

When an NFToken is minted, it may have a transfer fee associated with it.  If that transfer fee is non-zero, then a portion of the funds paid for the NFToken's transfer are syphoned off for the NFT's issuer.  That transfer fee is always paid in the same funds as were used for the transfer.

reviews.body: :+1: Two nits, fix them (or not) at your discretion.

reviewCommentsList.author: shawnxie999
reviewCommentsList.body:
Since the flagCreateTrustLines flag has been deprecated, would there be any consequences if we don't add this check? 

I think checking for the flag makes sense, I would just like to learn more about what kind of scenario this check would guard against. I'm thinking that some nodes may decide to enable `NonFungibleTokensV1_1` and `fixNFTokenTrustlineSurprise` amendments, but not enabling
 `fixRemoveNFTokenAutoTrustLine` for some reason? Just guessing here.

reviewCommentsList.author: scottschurr
reviewCommentsList.body:
Hi @shawnxie999, great question.  The `fixRemoveNFTokenAutoTrustLine` amendment did not deprecate `nft::flagCreateTrustLines`.  But it did deprecate the transaction flag `tfTrustLine`.  So after the amendment went live on October 27, 2022, new NFTokens could not be minted with `nft::flagCreateTrustLines` set.  That code lives here: https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/ripple/app/tx/impl/NFTokenMint.cpp#L56-L58

But there may be any number of NFTokens minted before October 27, 2022 that _do_ have the `nft::flagCreateTrustLines` flag set.  The code needs to continue to respect the flags on those older NFTokens.  That's why we need to continue to honor `nft::flagCreateTrustLines`.
